cases.question: 2026年8月青禾的创建订单数、支付订单数、有效订单数、净销售额分别是多少?

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS net_sales_cents
FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

cases.question: 2026年8月青禾的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数、月内复购率是多少?

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , case when valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_15.monthly_repeat_rate) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    case when monthly_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_buyer_count end AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    FROM sma_10001_cte
    WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_14
) subq_15
actual.answer:
2026年8月（自然月，全门店全渠道口径）青禾的会员购买与复购情况如下：
- 月内购买会员数：16,504 个会员账户（当月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数）
- 月内复购会员数：7,302 个会员账户（当月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数）
- 月内复购率：44.24%（7,302 ÷ 16,504，四舍五入到两位小数）

说明：统计单位为 CRM 会员账户，未按自然人去重；本月未附加任何门店或地区筛选，结果覆盖全部成交门店与渠道。8月为完整自然月，符合该指标的整月口径，数据范围在本客户测试库覆盖期内。

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , case when is_paid_eligible then valid_order_cnt else 0 end AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , case when is_paid_eligible then net_cents else 0 end AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    case when monthly_paid_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_paid_buyer_count end AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , case when monthly_paid_order_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_sales_cents / monthly_paid_order_count end AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    FROM sma_10001_cte
    WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_16
) subq_17
